jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist- Remote Central Time Zone
jobs.description:
**This is a fantastic opportunity for a recent college graduate to join our human resources department as an entry level employee with opportunities to grow with Certerra!**

Certerra is a growing national provider of testing, inspection, and certification services that support innovation in new product development, quality assurance, for project delivery, and engineered solutions for asset management. We are passionate about contributing to the sustainable development of the communities we serve. We are a national firm with a global reach serving national and international clients from 30\+ offices located in 10 states and are ranked on ENR’s Top 500 list alongside the nation’s top firms. With a 60\-year history, Certerra has a passion for high\-end services, constant innovation, and investment in the development of world\-class laboratory facilities, and interactive management technologies. Each member of our staff is committed to service, innovation, and the success of our clients.


**The Onboarding Specialist** is responsible for managing and coordinating the end\-to\-end onboarding process for new hires. This role ensures a seamless onboarding experience by facilitating pre\-employment requirements, including background checks, document completion, and compliance verification using systems such as ADP, DocuSign, Concentra, and Plexus. The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, highly organized, and able to manage multiple candidates simultaneously while maintaining a high level of accuracy and customer service.


**Central Time Zone residence needed.**

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and manage onboarding activities for new hires from offer acceptance through first day of employment
* Initiate and track background screenings, drug tests, and occupational health requirements using **Concentra**
* Process and monitor background checks and candidate records within **Plexus**
* Prepare, send, and track onboarding documents and offer packets via **DocuSign and ADP**
* Ensure all required documents are completed accurately and in compliance with company policies and legal requirements
* Communicate regularly with candidates to guide them through onboarding steps and resolve any issues
* Partner with HR, recruiting, and hiring managers to ensure timely onboarding and readiness of new hires
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records in HR systems and onboarding platforms
* Follow up on outstanding items, including incomplete paperwork, background results, and medical clearances
* Ensure confidentiality and security of sensitive candidate and employee information
* Identify opportunities to improve onboarding processes and enhance the candidate experience

### **Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, or related field preferred
* 1–3 years of experience in onboarding, HR administration, recruiting coordination, or related role
* Experience with onboarding and compliance systems such as **DocuSign, Concentra, ADP, and Plexus** or similar preferred
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook)
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion

### **Key Competencies**

* Detail\-oriented with strong accuracy
* Customer service mindset
* Time management and prioritization
* Problem\-solving skills
* Team collaboration and communication

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. This Company is dedicated to both the letter and the spirit of the equal opportunity employment laws. All applicants and all employees will be evaluated based on their ability, competence, and performance of the essential functions of their positions. There will be no discrimination based on race, sex, national origin, religion, age 40 and over, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other classification which may be protected by federal, state, or local laws. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, we specifically offer equal opportunity for all employees or job applicants who may have a physical or mental disability. Such people will be hired based on their ability to perform the essential functions of the job in question. Likewise, their work will be evaluated on their performance of these essential functions. We will offer reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities, to the extent that Company resources allow* *without undue hardship. As part of our equal employment policy, there will be no wage differentials based on gender, between men and women employed in the same establishment, on jobs that require equal skill, effort, and responsibility, and which are performed under similar working conditions.*

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
The Implementation Specialist plays a vital role in bringing new employer groups, health plans, vendors, and benefit programs to life. You'll be the go\-to connector between clients, brokers, stop\-loss carriers, pharmacy benefit managers, network partners, and our internal teams, making sure every benefit plan is set up accurately, on time, and in full compliance every step of the way.

In this role, you'll own implementation and renewal timelines from start to finish \- gathering and validating plan requirements, coordinating system configuration, and supporting eligibility and data file setup. You'll be the steady hand that keeps every operational team prepared and confident for a seamless transition to live administration. We're looking for someone with strong project coordination skills, a sharp eye for detail, solid knowledge of healthcare benefits administration, and a talent for communicating clearly and warmly with stakeholders at every level.

**HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT:**

* Coordinate the onboarding and renewal process for employer groups, health plans, vendors, and benefit programs.
* Serve as the primary implementation liaison between clients, brokers, vendors, carriers, internal teams, and technology partners.
* Develop, manage, and monitor implementation and renewal timelines to ensure milestones and deadlines are met.
* Gather, review, and validate plan design requirements, benefit specifications, eligibility rules, vendor requirements, and related documentation.
* Coordinate system configuration activities to ensure benefit plans are set up accurately within applicable administrative platforms.
* Support eligibility file setup, data file testing, vendor feeds, and other operational data requirements.
* Partner with internal departments, including claims, eligibility, customer service, account management, compliance, finance, and IT, to ensure operational readiness.
* Identify implementation risks, issues, and gaps, and work with appropriate parties to resolve them in a timely manner.
* Facilitate meetings, status updates, and communications throughout the implementation or renewal process.
* Maintain accurate records, project documentation, plan materials, and implementation checklists.
* Ensure all required documentation is complete, accurate, and available prior to the effective date or renewal date.
* Support post\-implementation review and issue resolution to ensure a successful transition to ongoing administration.
* Ensure implementation activities are completed in accordance with company policies, client requirements, regulatory standards, and contractual obligations.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**WHAT YOU BRING:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Previous experience in healthcare benefits administration, third\-party administration, health insurance, employee benefits, implementation, account management, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of medical benefits, eligibility, plan design, vendor coordination, and administrative processes.
* Experience coordinating projects, timelines, deliverables, and cross\-functional communication.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and Teams.
* Ability to work collaboratively with internal teams and external business partners.

**HOW WE SUPPORT YOU:** 

* 5% annual bonus based on company profitability
* Affordable health, vision, and dental insurance for you and your family
* Company contributes up to $2,300 to Health Savings Account annually
* Wellness program that contributes additional money towards your HSA
* Automatic 3% contribution into retirement plan
* Career development and growth opportunities
* Flexible Time Off \& 10 paid holidays per year

*MotivHealth is a dynamic and mission\-driven health insurance company dedicated to disrupting the status quo by making healthcare simpler and more affordable for our members. We believe in empowering our members to take control of their health and financial well\-being. Our innovative approach requires a team of passionate, talented individuals who aren't afraid to challenge conventional thinking and build solutions that truly make a difference. If you're looking to contribute your skills to a company that values innovation and positive impact, MotivHealth is the place for you.*

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Do you have previous experience in healthcare benefits administration, third\-party administration, health insurance, employee benefits, implementation, account management, or a related field?

Education:

* High school or equivalent (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
Under general supervision of the HR Manager and Recruiting Supervisor, the Onboarding Specialist (OS) will provide administrative support to the Recruiters on the Antarctic Support Contract (ASC). The OS will contribute to the overall success of the Recruiting Group by providing instruction and support to candidates preparing to deploy for contract work in Antarctica while assuring a high level of customer service and maintaining quality throughout the staffing process. During the peak periods, will be responsible for managing 300\+ candidates at various stages.



**Position Responsibilities:**


* Responsible for onboarding of all assigned candidates: collecting and processing of HR paperwork and guiding candidates through the Physical Qualification (PQ) process for deployment; administer background and drug screenings
* Make initial determinations and recommendations on candidate background and drug screenings; follow\-up with candidates to obtain supporting documentation for employment and education verification; present supplemental documentation for background screenings to the Recruiter for final approval
* Provide frequent instruction, support, and pertinent pre\-deployment details to candidates: assist in scheduling and billing of PQ appointments, communicate important timelines and deadlines for progressing through the process up until deployment
* Accurately submit and maintain participant files within the Pipeline database; regularly track changes in medical/deployment status and communicate to the appropriate parties
* Correspond with candidates via phone and email on a daily basis to ensure proper submission of required documents and overall engagement with on\-boarding procedures; send, receive, and track employment documents via email, fax and overnight mail
* Maintain accurate staffing updates within daily reports and Excel spreadsheets
* Collect and review candidate expense reimbursement requests to ensure accuracy and compliance with Amentum reimbursement policies; may assist with setting up direct bill options for candidates to complete the PQ process
* Works closely with the ASC Travel Department when making decisions about ticketing candidates: regularly exercises independent judgment when deciding if a candidate’s scheduled flight should be adjusted due to outstanding PQ/HR requirements.
* Works closely with the University of Texas Medical Branch (UTMB) to help facilitate questions for candidates and PQ status updates; decide which candidates are high priority and provide a weekly status report to UTMB.
* Provide guidance to candidates on program and company policies; may assist with providing ASC Program overview for new hires
* Responsible for managing confidential information to include background, medical, banking and other pre\-employment paperwork.
* Acts as a continued resource once candidates are hired to answer questions, help mitigate grievances and concerns that are brought forth.
* Responsible for identifying potential concerns and “red flags” in candidates that are working through the onboarding process; document concerns and provide detailed and accurate statements to both the Recruiter and Hiring Manager for further investigation.
* Perform other duties as assigned.


**Required Education, Experience, Certificates and Licenses:**


* High school diploma or GED
* Minimum two (2\) years of prior administrative experience within a high volume, fast paced customer service environment


**Expected Skills and Competencies:**


* Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills, including phone and email etiquette
* Must be detail oriented with excellent time management skills; able to maintain confidentiality as appropriate
* A great team attitude and ability to work harmoniously with others
* Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, MS Excel, MS Word, and Adobe Acrobat Pro, as well as utilizing various internet search functions.


**Preferred:**


* Experience in maintaining information in an Applicant Tracking System or other database
* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience
  



**Compensation Details:**


26\.03

jobs.title: Recruiter & Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Title: **Recruiter \& Onboarding Specialist**


Job Description

**Why Join Us?**


At CallonDoc, we value innovation, teamwork, and success. We are dedicated to transforming healthcare by providing accessible, affordable, and high\-quality telemedicine services. Our mission is to eliminate barriers such as long wait times and insurance restrictions, ensuring seamless access to trusted medical professionals anytime, anywhere.

  

We are seeking a Full\-Time Recruiter \& Onboarding Specialist with 2\+ years of recruiting experience and onboarding oversight. Someone who is driven, personable, and excited to help grow our organization. The ideal candidate will have proven success in sourcing, screening, and overseeing onboarding in a fast\-paced environment, with a strong understanding of role\-specific requirements. This role will support hiring managers, senior leadership, and HR.

  

This role requires a strategic thinker and self starter who can effectively manage relationships with both candidates and hiring managers. This role will play a crucial role in shaping our workforce and ensuring we attract and retain top talent in a growing business.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

**Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition**

* Partner with hiring managers across clinical and non\-clinical teams to understand hiring needs, role requirements, and workforce planning.
* Develop and execute targeted sourcing strategies using job boards, social platforms, professional networks, and healthcare\-specific channels.
* Screen candidates for qualifications, licensure (where applicable), cultural fit.
* Coordinate and manage interview processes, including scheduling, interviewer preparation, and candidate communication.
* Ensure a positive and efficient candidate experience from initial outreach through the offer stage.
* Conduct reference checks and verify credentials, including licenses, certifications, and background checks.
* Maintain accurate records in the applicant tracking system (ADP) and ensure compliance with hiring regulations.

 **Onboarding \& New Hire Experience**

* Partner with HR \& Shareholders to maintain, coordinate, and execute onboarding programs for both clinical and non\-clinical hires in a remote environment.
* Facilitate pre\-boarding activities, including offer letters, background checks, credentialing documentation, and system access setup.
* Ensure new hires complete required documentation (I\-9, W\-4, compliance forms, training through our LMS, etc.).
* Coordinate orientation sessions, introducing company culture, tools, workflows, and telemedicine protocols.
* Partner with department leaders to ensure timely provisioning of equipment, software access, and training resources.
* Monitor onboarding progress and ensure completion of required training and compliance modules.
* Create a feedback loop of feedback, to ensure a seamless onboarding experience for both new hires and internal team members.

 **Qualifications**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or related field is a plus but not required.

**Skills:**

* 2\+ years of experience in a recruiting function.
* 2\+ years managing onboarding in its entirety.
* Charismatic and personable, able to build rapport with candidates and managers.
* Competitive, goal\-driven mindset.
* Excellent organization and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Creative with sourcing strategies and problem\-solving.
* Comfortable improving processes in a small, growing company.

  

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Parental Leave
* Paid time off

Associate Implementation Consultant – Food & Nutrition Services
jobs.description:
**Who we are:**



Illumia is an industry leader in bringing the best integrated technology solutions to education, healthcare, and business campuses worldwide. Illumia was built on the collective expertise of two legacy cultures, and brings together people, technology, and insight to pioneer the art of the experience across the communities we serve. Be a part of this exciting organization and improving the lives of people doing mission\-critical work.


**Why join our team?**



We strive to provide the best customer experience in the industry and have succeeded with a single, strong motivating principle: We serve our user community.



Our success and growth are directly attributed to our people. Our newly named company is dedicated to fostering a culture of integrity, respect, and continuous personal development. We maintain an entrepreneurial spirit, where creativity, innovative problem\-solving, and learning agility drive our day\-to\-day actions.


**What you will be doing:**



As an Associate Implementation Consultant at Illumia, specializing as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for our NetMenu platform, you will play a critical role in delivering both on\-site and remote implementations for our Healthcare and Higher Education clients. Your hands\-on experience in kitchen and back\-of\-house food production operations, including inventory management, retail menu operations, purchasing and receiving, requisitions, and item and recipe creation, will be essential as you lead the deployment of NetMenu across campuses and sites. You will guide clients through best practices, ensuring successful outcomes and improved operational efficiency.


* Lead on\-site and remote implementations of the NetMenu platform, focusing on back\-of\-house food production operations within healthcare and higher education environments
* Deliver comprehensive training to kitchen and food service teams, sharing best practices tailored to back\-of\-house workflows including inventory management, retail menu operations, purchasing and receiving, and requisitions
* Collaborate closely with both internal teams and clients to ensure NetMenu is effectively integrated into food production and kitchen operations across campuses and sites
* Maintain documentation, including agendas, status reports, and implementation plans.
* Meet revenue and billable utilization goals through effective project delivery and client satisfaction
* Continuously expand your knowledge of NetMenu and related Illumia systems to remain the go\-to expert for food production, kitchen operations, and item and recipe management implementations


**Who you will work with:**


* External customers
* Internal customers including Implementation, Project Managers, Database Services, FNS Integration Services, Sales, Support and Managed Services


**What You'll Bring:**


* Bachelor's degree preferred, or 1 to 3 years of hands\-on experience in back\-of\-house kitchen operations within a healthcare or higher education setting
* In\-depth knowledge of food production operations including inventory management, retail menu operations, purchasing and receiving, and requisitions across campuses or sites
* In\-depth knowledge of item and recipe creation, including production recipes, yield testing, and standardized recipe management
* Strong experience with relevant systems and proficiency in training and presenting
* Excellent writing, communication, interpersonal, and human relations skills
* Effective time management, decision\-making, and organizational abilities
* Customer\-first mindset with a professional appearance
* Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Office suite
* Ability to manage stressful situations effectively


**Essential Functions of the job:**



The duties and responsibilities described in this job description are intended to represent the essential functions of the position as defined under applicable federal, state, and local labor laws, including the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). These functions are the fundamental job duties required for successful performance.



Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions unless such accommodations impose an undue hardship on the organization.



This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities. Duties may be added, removed, or modified at any time in accordance with business needs and applicable law.


**What is good to know:**


* Travel is required for this position and will fluctuate based on client needs, typically ranging from 50% to 75%, with travel primarily occurring Monday through Thursday. Can adhere to company travel and expense reimbursement policies
* Home office\-based when not traveling.
* Valid driver's license required.


**Our leaders are Humble, Hungry, and Smart:**


* **Humble:** The right leaders for Illumia don't need to own the spotlight — they share credit, define success collectively, and are quick to elevate the contributions of others. This is a company that still writes its story. The leaders who thrive here find energy in building something together, not in being recognized as the smartest person in the room.
* **Hungry: We** are not looking for caretakers. We are looking for leaders who are restless about what's possible, self\-motivated to close the gap between where we are today and where we need to be, and who are already thinking about the next opportunity before anyone asks.
* **Smart: At** Illumia, our leaders must operate across a complex, distributed organization spanning multiple product lines, two legacy cultures, and thousands of customers with competing priorities. Technical skills matter, but the ability to read a room, build trust across functions, and bring people along is what separates a great leader from one who burns the organization out.


This position is classified as **Exempt** under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) and applicable state wage\-and\-hour laws.


**What you get when you join our team:**


* Flexible time off to include paid holidays and volunteer time.
* Robust health, dental, and vision insurance plans on your first day of employment
* Employer\-paid life insurance/AD\&D/short\-term and long\-term disability insurance
* Comprehensive employee assistance program (EAP)
* Flexible spending account (FSA) or health savings account (HSA)
* Matched 401(k)
* Employee stock purchase plan


Base salary offers for this position may vary based on factors such as location, skills, and relevant experience. Some positions may include additional compensation in the form of bonus, equity, or commissions.



Your personal information will be handled in accordance with Illumia's **Candidate Privacy Notice**



Illumia is an equal employment opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, gender, age, religion, national origin, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, protected military/veteran status, or any other protected factor.

jobs.title: eClinicalWorks (eCW) Clinical EHR Trainer
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

MTS is a leading HIT company focused on delivering innovative technology solutions that support our healthcare providers and improve their ability to provide exceptional patient care.

We work exclusively with healthcare organizations across the United States, providing comprehensive and cost\-effective HIT and cloud solutions. Many on our staff have extensive experience working in healthcare – that’s helped MTS provide expertise to a client base that includes community health centers, ambulatory and specialty clinics, integrated networks, associations, and other healthcare\-focused organizations.

Our Core Values:

* We make it easy to do business with MTS
* We create a fun, high\-energy atmosphere
* We always do the right thing
* We always think long term
* We lead by serving others
* We are always learning and growing

**The eClinicalWorks (eCW) Clinical EHR Trainer is responsible for delivering end\-user training and supporting healthcare organizations in the effective use of the eClinicalWorks system.**

This role provides role\-based training to providers, nurses, medical assistants, and front\-office staff, with a focus on system functionality, standard workflows, and user adoption. The trainer may also assist with basic workflow review and identify opportunities for improved system use under the guidance of project leadership.

The ideal candidate has experience using eClinicalWorks, a solid understanding of clinical workflows, and strong communication and presentation skills.

**Work Schedule**

* Full\-Time
* Day Shift (8am \-5pm PST)
* Primarily remote, with local travel for onsite training and go\-live support in Los Angeles and surrounding areas.
* Occasional out\-of\-area or overnight travel may be required based on project needs.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Deliver remote and onsite eClinicalWorks training for providers, clinical staff, administrative users, and leadership teams.
* Conduct workflow discovery sessions and assess current\-state clinical operations.
* Develop recommendations for workflow improvements and EHR optimization.
* Configure and support templates, order sets, structured data, alerts, and clinical documentation workflows.
* Facilitate training sessions and optimization workshops.
* Create training materials, quick reference guides, and workflow documentation.
* Support EHR implementations, upgrades, go\-lives, and post\-go\-live optimization efforts.

* Collaborate with project managers, consultants, and technical teams to ensure project success.
* Build strong client relationships through exceptional customer service and subject matter expertise.
* Document consulting activities, findings, recommendations, and project deliverables.

**Key Skills and Experience**

Must Have

* Deliver remote and onsite eClinicalWorks training for providers, clinical staff, administrative users, and leadership teams.
* Provide role\-based instruction on eCW functionality and standard workflows.
* Assist with basic workflow review and communicate training needs or concerns to project leadership.
* Support users with templates, order sets, structured data, alerts, and clinical documentation workflows.
* Facilitate end\-user training sessions, refresher training, and system demonstrations.
* Create and update training materials, quick\-reference guides, and workflow documentation.
* Support EHR implementations, upgrades, go\-lives, and post\-go\-live training activities.

* Collaborate with project managers, consultants, and technical teams to complete assigned training activities.
* Provide responsive and professional customer service to clients.
* Document training activities, attendance, user feedback, and follow\-up needs.

Preferred

* Experience with EHR implementations and go\-live support.

* Quality reporting, Clinical Quality Measures (CQMs), UDS, or value\-based care experience.

**Experience**

* 2\+ years of eClinicalWorks experience required.
* 2\+ years of healthcare training, consulting, or clinical operations experience preferred.
* Experience working in community health centers or ambulatory healthcare settings preferred.

Salary Range: $70,000\-85,000 per year dependent upon experience.

Offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of job specific requirements, which may include a drug test, in accordance with applicable law.

Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $85,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Are you willing to travel intermittently occassionally?

Experience:

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90040

jobs.title: Onboarding Consultant
jobs.description:
Customer SuccessFull TimeOntarioRemote$70,000 \- $80,000 CAD per year

  

**Job Type:** Full\-time

**Role Type:** Permanent

**Location:** Remote, Canada


**Compensation:** $70,000\-80,000 CAD base salary

 **About us**


ACTO is an Intelligent Field Excellence (IFE) platform built for life sciences that unifies human intelligence with Empathetic AI to help Sales, Medical, Market Access, and Marketing teams improve customer engagement and brand performance. With ACTO, biopharma companies can ensure field professionals are always competent, confident, and credible in face\-to\-face HCP (healthcare professional) interactions As a validated platform compliant with FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and SOC 2 Type II certified, ACTO is the trusted partner for intelligent field excellence in the life sciences industry.

**Role Overview**
-----------------


In this expanded role, you will lead end\-to\-end implementations of ACTO Omnichannel across Pharmaceutical and Biotech organizations. You will operate as both a trusted onboarding strategist and the primary project manager, responsible for guiding customers through implementation, ensuring cross\-functional alignment, maintaining project governance, and driving successful go\-lives.


Your blended responsibilities allow for a seamless experience for clients, combining ACTO platform expertise, onboarding best practices, and a structured project management approach to deliver measurable value.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

***Implementation \& Customer Enablement***
-------------------------------------------

* Lead the implementation of ACTO Omnichannel capabilities for Established \& Emerging Pharmaceutical companies, as well as Enterprise and SMB MedTech companies.
* Understand the customer’s goals, success criteria, and strategic vision for ACTO, and develop a clear \& achievable implementation plan.
* Confidently provide product demonstrations and guidance, including ACTO’s AI\-enabled capabilities and appropriate use cases, to ensure stakeholder buy‑in ahead of go‑live.
* Build strong relationships with customers by equipping them with the knowledge, tools, and confidence needed for long‑term adoption and success.
* Coach clients on strategies for running a successful launch and sustaining adoption.
* Work cross\-functionally to improve implementation strategies, processes, and best practices, including identifying repeatable workflows that can be enhanced or automated through AI.
* Provide structured feedback to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to reduce friction and enhance the implementation experience.

***Project Planning \& Governance***
------------------------------------

* Own the creation, maintenance, and communication of the project plan, including scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and roles/responsibilities; leverage AI tools to strengthen planning, sequencing, risk identification, and prioritization.
* Lead all communications and sessions, ensuring all stakeholders understand objectives, deliverables, and success metrics; use AI\-generated meeting notes, including Zoom AI notes, to support pre\-call planning, prepare and send client agendas in advance, capture decisions and action items, and send timely follow\-up emails.
* Maintain clear responsibility mapping for complex implementations.
* Facilitate regular project governance meetings with client stakeholders and ACTO leadership, as required.

***Execution \& Cross‑Functional Coordination***
------------------------------------------------

* Coordinate tasks across Product, Data, Engineering, Sales, Services, and Customer Success teams to ensure seamless execution, as needed.
* Track deliverables, dependencies, risks, and blockers, escalating strategically to maintain project momentum.
* Ensure internal teams are aligned and informed of project status, upcoming needs, and customer expectations.
* Lead change management discussions when customer‑side scope, timelines, or requirements shift.
* Use approved AI tools, including ACTO AI and, where authorized, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other platforms, to streamline repetitive administrative work, improve efficiency, and create capacity for higher\-value client and project activities.

***Risk, Issue \& Change Management***
--------------------------------------

* Proactively identify potential risks and challenges during implementation.
* Develop and communicate mitigation plans to both clients and internal teams.
* Maintain a change log and ensure stakeholders approve adjustments to scope or timelines.
* Resolve both forecasted and unexpected issues, ensuring minimal disruption to the project schedule.

***Documentation \& Reporting***
--------------------------------

* Ensure thorough project tracking via Wrike, using AI\-generated meeting notes and summaries where appropriate to capture deadlines, decisions, action items, interactions, risks, and project progression.
* Maintain up\-to\-date project status reports, dashboards, timelines, and client\-facing materials for stakeholders and internal teams via Wrike, using AI tools to improve consistency, structure, and formatting while validating outputs for accuracy and completeness.
* Ensure customer data privacy and security standards are followed throughout implementation, including when using AI tools and AI\-generated content.
* Provide structured handoffs to Customer Success Team post‑launch with complete and accurate documentation.

**Critical Competencies**
-------------------------

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify complexity.
* Exceptional project management and organizational skills, including the ability to leverage AI to improve planning, prioritization, and execution.
* Business empathy to foster deep, consultative relationships with clients.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in fast‑paced and dynamic environments.
* Attention to detail and a strong sense of accountability.
* Demonstrated resourcefulness and problem\-solving ability, with sound judgment in selecting, prompting, and validating AI tools for the task at hand.
* Eagerness to learn and continuously improve both team and customer outcomes, including staying current on evolving AI capabilities and sharing practical best practices with the team.
* Comfort navigating ambiguity to create project structure where needed.
* Working knowledge of generative AI and agentic AI, including when and how to use each appropriately and the ability to build simple AI agents or workflows to support individual productivity and recurring tasks.

  

**What you’ll enjoy about ACTO*** Industry\-leading, multiple award\-winning technology;
* Competitive compensation package;
* Being part of a mission driven organization with the ability to drive solutions that focus on improving patient outcomes;
* Joining a results\-driven and collaborative culture;
* Remote work with opportunities for in\-person collaboration;
* Company MacBook;
* Budget for work\-from\-home set\-up;
* Monthly work\-from\-home allowance;
* Flex hours (overlapping with our core hours);
* Participation in group benefits plan;
* Flexible PTO.

 *At ACTO, we believe diverse and inclusive teams perform better. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodations during our interview process.*

*We may use AI\-powered tools during parts of our hiring process to help review applications and support candidate communication. These tools are designed to assist our team, but all final hiring decisions are made by human recruiters and hiring managers. If you have any questions or concerns about this process, please let us know. We thank everyone for their interest in ACTO. Only applicants selected for an interview will be contacted.*

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist II - RCM- Salt Lake City, Utah
jobs.description:
Kipu is bettering the behavioral health landscape, helping treatment centers achieve the best outcomes and empowering patients and caregivers on every step of the recovery journey. Join us in our work to advance behavioral health care in our communities. Our innovative solutions support providers in treating addiction, eating disorders, and many other behavioral health conditions. Our EMR, CRM, and revenue cycle solutions help behavioral health facilities succeed in managing their patients' entire care journey, but it is through our people that we truly make a difference.

**Role Overview**


The Implementation Specialist II, RCM independently owns end\-to\-end implementations for behavioral health treatment centers on the Kipu RCM platform. You will lead discovery, translate billing and revenue cycle requirements into configuration decisions, train end users, and drive accountability for timelines and deliverables. This role operates with minimal oversight and contributes to team quality through mentorship and process improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Discovery \& Solution Design**

* Lead discovery conversations to identify client billing workflows, payer mix, compliance requirements, and constraints.
* Translate client requirements into clear, actionable RCM configuration decisions aligned with best practices.
* Challenge misaligned or risky requests respectfully, explaining tradeoffs and downstream billing impacts.

**Configuration \& Data Quality**

* Configure billing workflows, payer rules, fee schedules, and system settings accurately on the first pass.
* Troubleshoot RCM configuration issues by identifying root causes rather than treating symptoms.
* Validate billing data for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before go\-live.

**Client Training \& Adoption**

* Deliver structured, goal\-oriented training that prepares clients to manage billing workflows independently.
* Equip client administrators to train their own teams on billing processes and system usage.
* Drive client accountability for tasks, timelines, and data deliverables.

**Project Delivery \& Risk Management**

* Own project documentation, ensuring records and project plans reflect reality.
* Identify risks early and document them with clear descriptions, owners, and mitigation plans.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional partners when scope, risk, or complexity warrants it.

**Go\-Live Readiness \& Adoption**

* Prepare clients for go\-live by validating that all billing readiness criteria are genuinely met.
* Support post\-go\-live adoption by tracking billing accuracy, claim submission rates, and early revenue cycle health.
* Contribute to process improvements and share learnings with peers and newer team members.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 2\-4 years of experience implementing an RCM system, or a combination of RCM implementation and technical support.
* 6\+ years of revenue cycle management experience.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to lead structured client meetings and drive decisions.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent projects with competing timelines.

**Preferred**

* Experience in behavioral health, mental health, or addiction treatment settings.
* Familiarity with EDI, ERA, clearinghouse processes, and payer enrollment workflows.
* Experience mentoring or supporting newer team members.

**Benefits \& Compensation**

* Flexible paid time off.
* 11 Paid Holidays.
* Health, Dental, Vision, Disability, and Life Insurance.
* Parental Leave.
* Pet Insurance.
* 401(K) with Company Match.

**Kipu Promise**


In an environment of rapid change, millions are struggling to cope. Kipu is here to help. Having shaped the industry for 10 years, today we focus on advancing our New Vision for the behavioral health ecosystem, evolving how it operates, interacts, communicates, and heals.


We are an equal opportunity employer and highly value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, gender identity, or disability status.

jobs.title: RN - Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Description:
***RN \- Implementation Specialist***

**Job Summary:**


Responsible for applications training, electronic health records (EHR) training, onsite support for staff and provider use of hospital\-based clinical information systems. Onsite support includes initial clinical systems training and ongoing support. This position supports hospital’s strategic use of data to improve clinical, operational, financial and quality outcomes. It serves as a bridge between information technology, clinical operations and leadership by managing data conversion projects, developing reports and dashboards, conducting data analysis and supporting EHR optimization initiatives.

**Essential Functions:**

* Provides initial and ongoing training to providers and staff on hospital applications, including EMR
* Collects input from care providers required for design and development of clinical information systems and collaborates in the design, build, analysis and improvement of clinical information systems
* Assists with data transfer assignments between the hospital and other entities.
* Assists with data mining and queries to write reports or data extractions to support all departments. Assignment includes the development and maintenance of departmental dashboards
* Ensure that the hospital achieves Meaningful Use targets, including communicating to relevant departments their progress in achieving Meaningful Use goals and assisting with the process to achieve the goals
* Participates in organization committees to share information about clinical user practices, needs and requirements. Facilitate communication with other support staff to respond to questions or provide additional support to care providers
* Communicates changes and/or new information, including EHR upgrades, in a timely and appropriate manner
* Work collaboratively with the other IT staff, providing limited technical support to clinical users and facilitate communication with technical resources when more advanced technical assistance is required.
* Prepares reports, dashboards, and data visualizations using tools such as Tableau and other tools.
* Conduct clinical system demonstrations as requested by organizational committees
* Enhance clinical user satisfaction by developing expanded and coordinated approaches to service delivery to care providers.
* Support application implementation, troubleshooting, and day\-to\-day system support activities.


All job requirements listed indicate the minimum level of knowledge, skills and ability deemed necessary to perform the job proficiently. This job description is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements. Employees will be required to perform other job\-related instructions given by their supervisor, subject to reasonable accommodation.

**Hours:** Full\-Time, Monday \- Friday.

**Salary:** Base salary of $42\.00 \- $43\.00 per hour. Additional increases based on preferred degrees.

**Company Overview:** Ellenville Regional Hospital is a non\-profit, community focused hospital based in New York’s Hudson Valley. We support our local community with health, wellness, specialty services and readily available diagnostic testing. We are centrally located for residents in surrounding areas to access our subacute rehabilitation programs, specialists and ambulatory services. Our healthcare is delivered with compassion and respect based on our commitment to improving our community health through excellence, innovation and state\-of\-the\-art technologies.

**Benefits:**

* Medical Benefits
	+ Health Insurance
	+ Dental
	+ Vision
* Life Insurance – Employer Sponsored, Supplemental Life Insurance
* PTO
	+ Vacation Time
	+ Sick Time
	+ Paid Holidays
	+ Personal Time
	+ Bereavement
* 403(b)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Tuition Assistance
* Discount Program
* Virtual fitness, mindfulness and nutrition app
* Healthcare Concierge Service
* MetLife Legal Plan
* LifeLock Identity Protection
* Nationwide Pet Insurance

**This is an in\-person, on\-site position and is not eligible for remote or hybrid work.**


Requirements:
**Experience:**

**Required:**

* Minimum of 2 years of healthcare or clinical informatics experience
* Hands\-on experience with EHR such as Meditech, AthenaOne, or similar platforms
* Understanding of healthcare workflows (inpatient, ambulatory, ancillary services such as Radiology, Rehabilitation services etc.)
* Hands\-on experience with visual analytics tools such as Tableau
* Experience as a super user for clinical systems supporting clinical users (physicians, nurses, allied health professionals, etc.)
* Familiarity with HIPAA and healthcare data privacy/security regulations

**Preferred:**

* Experience supporting technical systems in a professional environment
* Experience with report development, validation, and optimization
* Knowledge of healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR, ICD\-10, CPT, SNOMED)
* Familiarity with regulatory reporting requirements (CMS, Joint Commission, etc.)

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in health informatics, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field required
* Registered Nurse preferred but not required

**Certification/Skills:**

* Strong verbal, non\-verbal, and written communications skills Excellent interpersonal skills/customer services skills
* Critical thinking skills
